title: From Future of Work to Future of Workers: Addressing Asymptomatic AI Harms for Dignified Human-AI Interaction
reasoning: The paper proposes and evaluates a 'Dignified Human-AI Interaction Framework' that explicitly treats human dignity and agency as primary success metrics. By investigating and developing interventions to protect professional identity and worker dignity from AI-induced erosion, the research centralizes ethical concerns in the design and evaluation of human-AI systems.
